output.reason: The evidence shows that for this case (UCB as Example UCB; Tier 3; floating-rate; purpose non_business; borrower individual; sanctioned on/after Jan 1, 2026), the direction states a pre-payment charge is not permitted (para 261(1): “UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges”). The evidence also contains rows listing pre-payment charge rates of 2% and 3% of principal outstanding, payable on pre-payment or foreclosure. However, the evidence does not establish that these 2% and 3% figures come from the bank’s own loan-document clauses “in one version and another,” nor does it show the direction is an “RBI direction” (it refers to UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025).
